scope: fixed geometry pilot; three new predictions plus previous 6ZKW; all have experimental complex structures, no labeled nonbinding controls
protocol: AF2 multimer_v3 model1 seed42 at most3recycles unpairedMSA64:128 no templates

metric_protocol.contact_unit: unique residue pairs, not atom pairs
metric_protocol.atom_selection: observed non-hydrogen atoms; one highest-occupancy altloc per atom name
metric_protocol.coverage_policy: sequence-identical mapped positions with CA in both structures only
metric_protocol.missing_atom_limitation: unresolved native sidechains may reduce native contacts; heavy-atom coverage is reported
metric_protocol.interface_rmsd_definition: joint self-fit of native-interface CA atoms, custom metric, not DockQ iRMSD
metric_protocol.reference_use: post-prediction geometry evaluation only; no reference-based pose selection

cases.training_overlap: model structure-training/near-neighbor overlap not excluded; not independent generalization validation
